summary: Drop the GIT_* variables that select a repository or an identity in the pre-push evidence hook, st-test and ci-genie-freshness, with a shell scrub that works without compgen and checks itself, so fixture tests cannot act on the caller's repository

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this changes developer scripts, their tests and documentation only.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. Every check stays enforce false.

compatibility.detail: No command, frame, scope or stored-format change in the product.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action is required by this change; hosts that removed the installed hook after the incident get it back from the default development shell, now safe.

recovery.detail: No persistent product state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
